  Doc: DocComment "Taxonomy of the team board (internal.ragyra.com).\n\nRewrite of sovcommon/teamboard/taxonomy.json v7. The ~30 load-time checks in\nload.go and refs.go become three things here:\n  - types: unknown refs, roles, tones, icons, setBy, fields, duplicate or\n    badly formed ids, required fields. There is no code for any of them.\n  - stable tables: \"never renamed, never reused, retire instead of delete\".\n  - the eight `check`s at the bottom: the rules that are truly about this data.\n\nThe reporter makes ONE classification: WHERE did you see it (area). Everything\nfiner is said in the text; routing to a technical area is the triager's move." @1:1-11:82
